reflections.summary: Lost primarily because the team-preview plan exposed Mega Tyranitar to Mega Gardevoir’s Fairy pressure and Skarmory’s Body Press without securing speed control; after Tyranitar fell, the remaining core could not stop repeated Moonblast and Close Combat pressure. Mega Tyranitar was a poor Mega choice for this matchup.
reflections.adjustment: Next game, replace Tyranitar with Incineroar and do not build the lead around Mega Tyranitar: use Fake Out, Intimidate, and Flare Blitz to pressure Skarmory and disrupt Sneasler while preserving Milotic and using Whimsicott to establish Tailwind safely.
reflections.notebook: Opponent’s revealed mode is Mega Gardevoir special spread pressure paired with Sneasler Close Combat and Skarmory Tailwind/Body Press; Sinistcha can provide redirection and sustain. Avoid exposing Mega Tyranitar to this combination, and prioritize Incineroar for disruption and Skarmory pressure. Preserve Milotic as a stabilizing answer to physical attackers, but do not rely on it to endure repeated double-targeting without speed control. Whimsicott should prioritize Tailwind from a protected position rather than spending its only safe turn on Encore.

reflections.summary: Won by removing Tyranitar-Mega and Whimsicott early with Gardevoir/Skarmory, then breaking Milotic's Protect with Sneasler's Close Combat after its consecutive-use failure. The team's speed and pressure prevented Milotic from stalling out.
reflections.adjustment: In game 3, avoid stat-lowering moves (e.g., Moonblast) on Milotic to prevent Competitive boost. Lead Sneasler if Arcanine/Lopunny are expected, and consider Gardevoir's Hyper Voice for safe spread damage. Also watch for Milotic's Protect conditioning and don't rely on breaking it without a read.
reflections.notebook: Milotic: Bold, Competitive, Sitrus consumed; Scald/Ice Beam/Haze/Protect; Protect success drops after consecutive use. Whimsicott: Prankster, sash, Encore. Tyranitar-Mega: Adamant, Rock Slide/Crunch/Low Kick/Protect. Gholdengo: Life Orb, Good as Gold, Nasty Plot/Shadow Ball/Make It Rain/Protect. Bench threats: Arcanine (Careful, Shuca, Intimidate) and Lopunny (Jolly, Black Belt, Limber) may be brought next game. Gardevoir-Mega (Modest, Pixilate) remains key special cleaner; Sneasler (Jolly, Focus Sash, Unburden) is the fast physical answer to Intimidate/Fake Out leads. Respect Competitive: never lower Milotic's stats.
